---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, a new haunt, a room, an item…
title: "[idea] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The idea**
A clear description of what you'd like.

**Why**
What it would add to the game.

**Notes**
For new content, remember it must be **original** — no names, text, art, or
scenarios lifted from any commercial game. Mechanics are fair game; expression
is not.
